abstract: Cisco's survey of 7,950 global business and technical decision-makers across 30 countries reveals that agentic AI is expected to handle 68% of all customer service and support interactions with technology vendors by 2028, with 56% expected within the next 12 months. The research highlights overwhelming organizational demand for agentic AI transformation, with 93% of respondents predicting it will enable more personalized, proactive, and predictive services, though 89% emphasize the importance of combining human connection with AI efficiency.
keyFindings: 68% of all customer service and support interactions with technology vendors are expected to be handled by agentic AI by 2028, with 56% expected within 12 months.
92% of organizations report that the support and services they receive from technology vendors are more important than ever due to growing IT complexity.
93% of respondents predict that agentic AI will enable more personalized, proactive, and predictive services.
89% of customers emphasize the need to combine human connection with AI efficiency, and 96% state that human relationships are very important when interacting with B2B technology partners.
81% of respondents predict that vendors successfully delivering agentic AI-led customer experience will gain a competitive edge, and 99% consider robust governance for ethical AI use non-negotiable.
methodology: Global survey of 7,950 business and technical decision-makers across 30 countries conducted by Cisco. Survey respondents were asked about their expectations for agentic AI adoption in customer service interactions and the benefits and governance requirements for AI-led customer experience.
